title: A firewall 403 on a write is LIVE_BLOCKED, never an unknown outcome, and the push goes on
steps: Apply two posts with a non-engine 403 on one content.update; apply a Joomla lot with a 403 on content.batch.
expect: The blocked item is failed LIVE_BLOCKED with a refused receipt; the other is written; the lot items are LIVE_BLOCKED and the Apply answers ok.

tests: a firewall’s 403 on one write is LIVE_BLOCKED
a blocked batch retains earlier writes in the Apply answer and Undo
